newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's Yieh Lien in T$2 bln steel investment.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's Yieh Lien in T$2 bln steel investment.

text.p: Taiwan steel maker Yieh Lien Steel Ltd said on Friday it would invest T$2 billion to build a stainless steel plate production line with annual capacity of 50,000 tonnes.
The production line would be completed in September 1998, a company official told Reuters by telephone.
Yieh Lien is a subsidiary of a major Taiwan steelmaker, Yieh Loong Corp.
Yieh Loong has invested T$10 billion in Yieh Lien, which can produce 800,000 tonnes of stainless steel plate and other steel products a year, he added.
The official said Yieh Lien projects its 1997 revenue at T$36 billion and could boost that to T$40 billion with the plant expansion.
